correctness.rationale: For every n>=3 the face condition is Hamming diameter at most 2. The cited Adamaszek–Adams wedge theorem supplies H_3 concentration. For a nonzero translation of weight 1 or 2, invariant faces are orbit-unions; their signed Lefschetz sum reduces to the Euler characteristic of a triangle-free n-1 cube graph on 2^(n-1) orbit vertices and (n-1)2^(n-2) edges. For weight >=3 no orbit lies in a simplex. Thus the stated traces, Walsh Fourier multiplicities, and dimension C(n,3) follow; distinguished even-parity tetrahedra support independent three-cube fundamental cycles, giving the exterior-cube S_n action on T-invariants. An independently authored face-enumeration/reduced Lefschetz check (not merely executing the repository verifier) confirmed all translation weights for n=3,4,5 (80,392,1776 simplices respectively), and n=4 traces 9 at identity, 5 for weights 1/2, 1 above. These finite checks are only corroboration of the uniform proof.
